title: Automated access provenance and certification bundles for tenant-aware compliance
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Security and compliance teams need tamper-evident, tenant-scoped evidence bundles that prove who had access to which resources, when, and why. Current ad-hoc exports are manual, error-prone, and don’t tie provisioning events (SCIM) to authentication events (SAML/SSO) or runtime role changes (RBAC) across Dedicated and Private deployments with data residency constraints.

Goal: Build an automated pipeline that stitches identity provisioning (SCIM), authentication (SAML/SSO), and internal RBAC audits into a single, signed access provenance artifact per tenant. The system should: 1) respect tenant data residency and retention policies, 2) support periodic access review workflows with automated reminders and reviewer attestations, and 3) emit compliance-ready evidence bundles (PDF + machine-readable manifest) that can be ingested by GRC tools or downloaded by customers.

Scope: MVP focuses on hosted + Dedicated tenants, support for tenant residency tags, SCIM delta ingestion, SAML login correlation, RBAC role-change events, and a signed export format with hashes and a manifest. On-prem Private deployment support will be handled in a follow-up spike (ENG-52912).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Access provenance pipeline ingests SCIM provisioning events, SAML authentication events, and RBAC audit events for a tenant and correlates them into a time-ordered event stream.
2) System produces a signed evidence bundle per tenant for a chosen timespan (start/end) with: event manifest (JSONL), human-readable summary (PDF), and integrity signature.
3) Bundles are generated on-demand via Console and via API (download endpoint) and scheduled exports (weekly/monthly) for tenants with retentionContracts.
4) Export respects tenant data residency and retention settings; if a tenant is EU-resident, evidence is stored and exported from eu-1 region.
5) Periodic access review automation kicks off with reviewer assignments, email reminders, and consolidated attestation records stored in the evidence bundle.
6) End-to-end tests validating correlation logic, residency routing, and signature verification exist and run in CI.
7) Documentation (Console UX, API spec, and runbook) published and linked in the ticket.
steps: 1) Design event schema for unified access events (provision, auth, role-change, attestation). 2) Implement SCIM delta consumer in ingestion service and normalize to unified schema. 3) Add SAML login hooks to streaming event bus and normalize. 4) Extend RBAC service to emit signed role-change events with requestor context. 5) Build correlation engine (time-window + identifiers) and retention-aware storage layer. 6) Implement bundle generator: JSONL manifest + PDF summary + signature (KMS). 7) Console: export UI and review workflow; API endpoints for programmatic exports. 8) E2E tests, performance checks, and privacy/regional routing tests.
decisions: Use KMS-backed signatures for evidence bundles to provide tamper-evidence and rotation support.
Correlate events primarily on immutable provisioning IDs (SCIM id) and fallback on canonical email with verification window.
Expose scheduled exports as tenant-configurable (weekly/monthly/custom) with soft-delete hold period matching retention policy.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created after compliance intake with Acme Corp. They requested per-tenant signed evidence and reviewer attestations for quarterly audits.
2026-03-05 - Miguel Santos: Spike completed for SCIM delta consumer; discovered SCIM payloads from some IdPs omit 'externalId' - added normalization rule to fallback to email+idp.
2026-03-08 - Security review (informal): flagged need for KMS key rotation policy and proof of export origin in manifest. Added to decisions.
2026-03-10 - PM review (Riley Chen): Requested that exports include a redaction marker for fields that contain PII when tenant retention policy requires partial redaction.
2026-03-13 - Eng review: Correlation engine prototype runs at expected throughput for medium tenants; latency ~120ms/event. Next: integrate residency routing and signature service.

2026-03-14 - QA: Added test plan for scheduled exports and attestation flows. Found an edge case where a late SCIM delta could reorder events; plan to add idempotency tokens and event-sequencing rules.
